Watson.look: A thin, sun-browned man of about thirty in a worn tweed suit, haggard face, left arm held stiffly; an army doctor back from Afghanistan.

Holmes.look: A tall, excessively lean man over six feet, sharp piercing eyes, thin hawk-like nose, hands blotted with ink and stained with chemicals; in a purple dressing-gown, a pipe in his hand.

Commissionaire.look: A stalwart, plainly-dressed man walking slowly down the street, a large blue envelope in his hand; a retired sergeant of Royal Marines.

scenes.title: 221B Baker Street: the brain-attic, the Book of Life, and the retired sergeant
scenes.place: The sitting-room at 221B Baker Street on a cold morning in March 1881: two broad windows looking onto the street, a breakfast table with coffee and toast, a magazine with a pencil-marked article, an arm-chair, a sofa, a fireplace, a violin on the mantelpiece, chemical apparatus on a side-table, shelves of books and papers.
